  "question_quote": "On BUK and the £8.2 billion implied NII figure, I know you said middle of the £8.1 billion to £8.3 billion range, but let's just work with £8.2 billion for the sake of argument. Is that specifically assuming 3.5% swap reinvestment in the second half?",
  "answer_quote": "At the beginning of the year, we gave you a range of £8.1 billion to £8.3 billion on BUK [NII guidance] and we said that the reason for that range was actually around how we felt around the uncertainty on deposit dynamics in particular. }
